caseName: Charles J. Webb & Co. v. Pingree Cattle Loan Co.
caseNameFull: Charles J. Webb & Company v. Pingree Cattle Loan Company
attorneys: Mr. S. L. Hodgin, with whom Mr. C. S. Wesley was on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. J. H. Peterson and Mr. T. C. Coffin appeared for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
